title: MSc Research Survey: Burnout and Alert Fatigue in Security Operations
description: This is a research survey investigating burnout, cognitive workload, and alert fatigue among security operations personnel such as SOC analysts, incident responders, and threat hunters. The survey is anonymous and voluntary, aiming to gather data on workplace factors contributing to these issues in security operations centers. There is no indication of a security vulnerability or threat in this content.
